Workflows.title: Access simulator home page and dismiss welcome modal to view main dashboard
Workflows.goal: Welcome modal dialog appears; Main dashboard with account summaries and top navigation is displayed

1. Open home page and click GET STARTED NOW button — Welcome modal dialog appears
2. Dismiss welcome modal by clicking Ok — Main dashboard with account summaries and top navigation is displayed

test_steps.action: Open home page and click GET STARTED NOW button
Dismiss welcome modal by clicking Ok
test_steps.expected: Main dashboard with account summaries and top navigation is displayed
